title: HR Administrator
company: Crossroads Truck & Bus Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
Are you an organised and proactive HR administrator looking for your next opportunity? We're seeking a HR Administrator to join our team on a 6-month fixed-term contract, supporting a wide range of HR activities and helping to deliver an excellent employee experience.

Crossroads Truck & Bus Ltd is the Volvo Truck and Bus specialists across Yorkshire and Lincolnshire. We provide a total transport solution for the industry, from new trucks to used trucks, and parts and servicing for trucks, buses and trailers.

The Role

You'll provide day-to-day HR administrative support across the employee lifecycle, including:
- Providing administration support for the induction process.
- Maintaining employee records and HR systems.
- Supporting managers with HR processes.
- Providing first-line HR support to employees and line managers.
- Liaising with payroll on starters, leavers and employee changes.
- Benefits administration including pension & health care.
- Producing HR reports and management information.
- Supporting employee engagement activities such as long-service awards.
- Assisting with general HR administration and compliance processes.

About You

We're looking for someone who has:
- Ideally previous HR administration experience.
- Ideally experience using HR systems and maintaining accurate records.
- A good understanding of HR policies and procedures.
- Strong Microsoft Office skills.
- Excellent communication and organisational skills.
- High attention to detail and a professional, confidential approach.

Qualifications: Good GCSEs and/or A-Levels, or a relevant degree/equivalent qualification.

What Do We Offer?
- Loyalty bonus.
- In house training.
- Excellent contributory pension scheme.
- Rewards gateway platform available for scheme members.
- Access to Les Mills and House of Wellbeing classes through the GoJoe app.

Crossroads Truck and Bus prides ourselves on providing excellent levels of customer service first time every time. Our commitment to our staff, training and well-being is at the forefront of our business.

title: HR Administrator
description:
Interim Administrator - HR

Term-Time Only
Full-time or 4 days per week
c.£22,000 actual salary (c.£26,000 FTE)
Start: October 2026
Initially until December, likely to extend into 2027

Are you an experienced Administrator who is highly organised, confident with Excel and enjoys getting stuck into a variety of projects?

We are working with an established organisation to recruit an Interim Administrator - HR to provide additional support during a particularly busy period.

This is a varied, project-focused administration role supporting a busy HR function with recruitment, onboarding and wider administrative activity. You don't necessarily need previous HR experience - strong administration skills, attention to detail and the ability to pick things up quickly are most important.

The role

Working closely with the HR team, you'll provide practical administrative support across a range of projects and priorities, including:
- Preparing recruitment and induction documentation
- Supporting recruitment and onboarding administration
- Creating, maintaining and updating Excel spreadsheets and trackers
- Coordinating documentation and ensuring information is accurate and up to date
- Attending meetings and supporting with notes and actions where required
- Helping to keep projects and key activities moving forward
- Providing additional administrative support across the HR function as priorities arise

This isn't a reception or telephone-based administration role. You'll be given responsibility for your own workload, so we're looking for someone who is comfortable using their initiative and getting on with the task at hand.

About you

You'll be a capable and adaptable Administrator who enjoys working in a busy environment and can quickly become a trusted pair of hands.

We're particularly interested in candidates who can demonstrate:
- Strong previous administration experience
- Excellent Excel skills and confidence working with spreadsheets
- Strong organisation and attention to detail
- The ability to manage changing priorities
- A proactive, self-sufficient approach
- Good written communication skills
- The ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with colleagues

Previous HR, recruitment or onboarding administration experience would be useful but isn't essential. Solid administration experience is the priority.

The opportunity

This is a term-time-only interim position and is expected to run at least until December, with a strong possibility of continuing into the new year.

The role can be considered on a full-time or four-day-per-week basis.

There may also be potential for the opportunity to develop into something longer term, particularly for someone who brings relevant HR experience.

If you're an experienced Administrator looking for a varied interim opportunity and are available to start during October, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply now or contact Leanne Boddy at Macmillan Davies for further information.

title: HR Coordinator
description:
Job: HR Coordinator
Location: Leeds
Salary: £28,000 - £36,000 per annum
Hours: Monday - Friday, 8.30am - 5pm
Hybrid working available following successful completion of probation

About the Opportunity
Are you an HR professional looking for a role where you can broaden your experience, work closely with managers and become genuinely involved in the day-to-day people agenda?

We are recruiting for an established organisation with a nationwide presence that is looking to appoint an enthusiastic and capable HR Coordinator to join their established HR function.

This is a varied role offering exposure across the employee lifecycle, from recruitment and onboarding through to employee relations, performance, absence and general HR support. You'll work closely with managers across the business, providing practical HR support and helping to ensure people processes are handled professionally, consistently and effectively.

It's an excellent opportunity for someone who already has a good HR foundation and wants to develop their knowledge and responsibility within a broader HR environment.

The Role
You'll become a key point of contact for employees and managers, supporting a wide range of HR activity across the business. Your responsibilities will include:
- Supporting managers with day to day HR queries, providing practical guidance and escalating more complex matters where appropriate.
- Assisting with employee relations activity including investigations, disciplinary and grievance processes, absence management and performance concerns.
- Attending HR meetings, taking accurate and confidential minutes and preparing correspondence, meeting documentation and outcome letters.
- Coordinating recruitment activity from vacancy approval and advertising through to interviews, offers and onboarding.
- Building positive relationships with hiring managers and ensuring candidates receive a professional experience throughout the recruitment process.
- Managing new starter and leaver processes, including contracts, references, right to work checks, HR system updates and exit documentation.
- Maintaining accurate employee records and ensuring changes to contracts, salaries and personal details are processed correctly.
- Supporting the delivery of HR policies, procedures and initiatives across the wider business.
- Preparing HR reports, management information and documentation for internal requirements, PQQs and tender submissions.
- Supporting HR projects and process improvements, looking for ways to make the employee experience and HR service more effective.
- Handling employee queries professionally and sensitively, ensuring confidentiality is maintained at all times.
- Working collaboratively with managers and colleagues across the organisation to ensure HR processes are applied consistently and effectively.
- Keeping up to date with employment legislation and HR best practice and supporting the wider team with compliance.

About You
We're looking for someone who is organised, approachable and commercially minded, with a genuine interest in people and HR.

You may currently be working as an HR Coordinator, HR Administrator, HR Advisor, People Advisor or in a similar HR focused role and be ready for an opportunity that gives you greater exposure and responsibility.

We're particularly interested in candidates who can demonstrate:
- Previous experience working within an HR or People function.
- Some practical employee relations exposure - we're interested in what you've actually been involved in, rather than requiring extensive end to end ER experience.
- A sound understanding of UK employment legislation and HR processes.
- Excellent organisation, administration and attention to detail.
- Strong communication skills and the confidence to build relationships with employees and managers.
- The ability to manage sensitive information with professionalism and discretion.
- A proactive approach, with the confidence to take ownership and get things done.
- A genuine desire to develop your HR career.

What's On Offer?
- £28,000 - £36,000 salary
- Monday - Friday, 8.30am - 5pm
- Hybrid working following successful completion of probation
- Exposure to HR activity across a nationwide organisation
- Genuine opportunity to develop your employee relations experience
- A varied role with plenty of scope to learn and take ownership
- Supportive and collaborative HR environment
- Opportunities for long-term career development and progression

If you're looking for a role that offers more than traditional HR administration and want the opportunity to develop your experience across the wider HR function, we'd love to hear from you.

Our Guarantee

Thank you for your initial expression of interest in our available vacancy. If we have not contacted you within 5 working days of your application, please understand that the CV received and the information provided does not meet the requirements of the current vacancy. However, we will consider all applications for any available opportunity, present or future, and proactively contact you should we deem there to be a suitable match.

We are committed to supporting equal opportunities and prohibit discrimination or harassment of any kind based on protected characteristics.

title: HR Onboarding Coordinator
description:
The Opportunity

This is a fantastic opportunity to join our client, a global insurance firm, in their Leeds office as an HR Onboarding Coordinator on a 12-month fixed-term contract.

Working closely with HR, Talent Acquisition and hiring managers, you will take ownership of the onboarding process from offer acceptance through to a new starter's first day. You will coordinate pre-employment screening, background checks, contracts, references and new joiner communications, ensuring candidates and managers are kept informed throughout.

This is a highly organised, people-focused role where you will be responsible for keeping the process moving, proactively chasing outstanding actions and providing a seamless candidate experience.

Key Accountabilities
- Coordinate pre-employment screening, right to work and compliance checks, escalating any issues where required.
- Support with reference checking and develop an understanding of DBS requirements and the legal requirements behind screening decisions.
- Prepare and issue contracts, ensuring any adjustments are captured correctly and escalated for approval. Contracts should be issued within 48 hours of initial notification.
- Act as a key point of contact for candidates, responding to queries and providing regular updates. You should be comfortable picking up the phone and speaking directly with candidates.
- Work closely with HR, Talent Acquisition and hiring managers, proactively providing updates and chasing outstanding actions.
- Ensure managers are prepared for new starters and that day-one arrangements are in place.
- Complete onboarding administration, including new joiner communications, adding candidates to relevant systems and maintaining accurate trackers.
- Monitor candidates throughout the onboarding process, including those with longer notice periods, and ensure actions remain on track.
- Audit candidate files to ensure data is accurate and up to date.
- Troubleshoot issues, identify when escalation is required and coordinate appropriate resolutions.
- Identify opportunities to improve the onboarding process and candidate experience.

What We're Looking For

We are looking for someone who is highly organised, proactive and confident working in a fast-paced, high-volume environment.

You will ideally have:
- Experience in HR, Talent Acquisition, recruitment coordination or a similar high-volume administrative role.
- Excellent communication skills and confidence speaking with candidates and stakeholders over the phone.
- Strong attention to detail, time management and problem-solving skills.
- A proactive approach to chasing outstanding information and keeping processes moving.
- The ability to manage multiple candidates, deadlines and competing priorities.
- A strong customer and candidate focus, with the ability to build relationships quickly.
- Experience using Excel and Microsoft Office.
- Workday experience would be desirable.
- Experience working with a third-party background screening provider would be advantageous.

Previous experience of pre-employment screening, DBS or compliance checks is beneficial but not essential, as training will be provided.

Why Join Us?

This is a great opportunity to build your career within HR, gaining broad experience across onboarding, pre-employment screening, compliance and candidate experience within a global insurance business.

You'll receive support during your first few months to learn the screening systems, compliance requirements and wider business, before becoming self-sufficient and taking full ownership of your workload.

If you're organised, proactive, people-focused and enjoy making sure things get done, we'd love to hear from you!
